question: Can the fixed 75% 10R, 25% cloud runner use its original 34.61% drawdown headroom to achieve the revised growth objective?
single_variable: Change only the notional multiple of each funded isolated margin reservation, 1 (frozen comparison), 1.25, 1.5 or 2. cash: 1,000 USDT initial. Single shared cash account. Actual native 12H confirmation entry/stop/EMA exit and resting 10R target. VectorBT holds positive collateral shares whose price changes exactly reproduce signed linear-perpetual PnL. Charge taker 5bp and maker 2bp on actual underlying notional. Charge 5bp adverse slippage separately on market orders in stress run. Historical funding and mark-based margin tiers are not yet certified.
risk: Reject a multiple if any observed original holding crosses a conservative 10% isolated maintenance buffer plus close fee. Compare the 1x adapter to the original full trade roster, cash profits, and hourly upper/lower NAV. Any rates or missing holding hours left unresolved preclude labeling the result fully verified.
selection: Highest through-2024 ending NAV among development arms with win >=20%, money payoff >=2.5 and hourly upper drawdown <=50%. All later calendar windows were previously explored. Apply additional 5bp market slippage to selected multiple.
